change_summary: The notice is titled as a retraction of the tracked paper, High-yield ethanol extraction of curcumin from turmeric. The paper was retracted because the reported yields could not be reproduced and the raw data were found to have been altered. The paper's abstract reports that a single ethanol extraction recovered 94% of the curcumin in turmeric powder, a yield result.
